hypothesis: If the harness owns the loop and asks exactly one question per cached conversation branch, Qwen3-8B can choose exactly one FOUND or EMPTY tool without silently losing questions, while preserving grounded evidence.

tools.name: send_found
tools.meaning: A directly supporting answer exists in the conversation.

tools.name: send_empty
tools.meaning: The conversation does not contain the requested answer.

harness_law: Ordinary code starts one branch per question and requires exactly one valid tool call. Missing or malformed calls become ERROR, never silent absence.

gold_correction_before_rerun.reason: Exact post-run rehydration in Gate 16C proved the original D1/D2 message number was wrong.
